title: Crowsscope
description: Crows Scope Mod adds a new sniper-inspired weapon with a unique scope that offers a golden experience in Minecraft 1.21.4.
body:
🎯 CROWSSCOPE – Long-Range Combat Redefined
Minecraft Version: 1.21.4
Mod Loader: NeoForge 21.4.123

🛠️ Craft Your Ultimate Precision Weapon
CROWSSCOPE introduces a custom-crafted long-range scoped weapon designed for high-impact sniping.

🔧 Crafting Recipe:
1 Crossbow

2 Amethysts

1 Diamond

1 Iron Ingot

1 Iron Nugget

1 Stick

🎯 How It Works:
When held in your main hand, the scope activates and immobilizes the player to simulate precise aiming.

Switch it to your off-hand to enable the long-range scoped view.

Requires just 1 arrow per shot.

Each shot deals a massive 3 rows of hearts in damage – perfect for stealth takedowns or powerful defense.

✅ Features:
Unique scoped combat mechanic

Balanced crafting recipe

Lightweight and focused mod

Fully compatible with NeoForge mods

🔍 Perfect For:
Tech-based or military modpacks

Players looking for immersive ranged combat

Custom survival or PvP-focused worlds

💬 Have suggestions or feedback? Let me know in the comments — updates and improvements are coming!

🧪 Tested & Optimized
Built specifically for NeoForge 21.4.123 — performance and compatibility guaranteed.
